Long Haul

避开天气

Flight planning or tactical maneuvering to avoid hazardous weather areas using deviation, rerouting, or altitude changes.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 避开天气?

In this glossary, 避开天气 refers to: Flight planning or tactical maneuvering to avoid hazardous weather areas using deviation, rerouting, or altitude changes.

How is 避开天气 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "请求在航线以东绕飞以避开恶劣天气，前方有强雷暴。"

Why does 避开天气 matter in aviation?

避开天气 matters because it supports clear communication in Long Haul contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses 避开天气?

避开天气 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does 避开天气 belong to?

In this glossary, 避开天气 is grouped under Long Haul. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Flight planning or tactical maneuvering to avoid hazardous weather areas using deviation, rerouting, or altitude changes.

Operational example

Requesting deviation for weather avoidance east of track, severe thunderstorm ahead.

Localized term

避开天气

Localized example

请求在航线以东绕飞以避开恶劣天气，前方有强雷暴。
